title: Human Cognitive Architecture — Cognitive Coordinator + Cognitive Brains + Executive foundation
summary: Migrates the M17 Perception Hub into a Cognitive Coordinator. FRIDAY is now a society of specialized Cognitive Brains, each owning local reasoning/state/memory and emitting structured Situation Reports. The Coordinator merges/de-duplicates/conflict-resolves those reports into Unified Situations and is the only gateway into the Executive Brain (the CEO), which consumes only situations — never raw data. A dedicated Memory Brain owns the tiered memory hierarchy + semantic Knowledge Graph. Additive on M16 services + M17 hub (reused); no completed milestone rewritten.

layout.core/brains/{vision,audio,spatial,learni: Cognitive Brains (wrap existing subsystems via services; local caches; reports)
layout.core/brains/memory/: Memory Brain — tiers.py (Working→Core promotion) + knowledge_graph.py (semantic graph) + brain.py (sole memory owner)
layout.core/brains/executive/: Executive Brain foundation (M18) — consumes Unified Situations, owns Working Memory, decisions/focus/delegation; refuses raw data
layout.core/coordinator/: Cognitive Coordinator (this) — situation reports -> unified situations -> Executive

coordinator_responsibilities: publish only to the Executive Brain

executive_brain.role: CEO — decision making, planning, prioritization, delegation, focus
executive_brain.input: ONLY Unified Situation Reports (refuses frames/audio/detections/db/scene graphs)
executive_brain.memory: owns ONLY Working Memory; all other memory via the Memory Brain

graceful_degradation: each brain runs independently; if one fails the others continue, the Coordinator adapts, and the Executive reasons with available information
public_api: cycle() -> tick all brains + coordinate -> unified situations to Executive
brain(name) / start(interval) / stop() / dashboard() / metrics() / health() / manifest() / attach(runtime)
invariants: no raw sensor data leaves a Cognitive Brain (only Situation Reports)
the Coordinator is the only gateway into the Executive Brain
the Executive Brain never processes raw data and owns only Working Memory
the Memory Brain is the sole owner of memory (no direct DB access elsewhere)
brains communicate only through services + the report/event buses (no internal imports, no circular deps)
every brain runs independently; one failing never stops the society
no hardcoded configuration; no side effects at import
